subject: Next steps: Arkhaven POC acceptance criteria & integration plan
messages:
From: Priya Raina <priya.r@arkhaven.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@arkhaven.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — Arkhaven evaluation priorities

Thanks for the demo earlier — very helpful. A quick recap from our side and a few clarifications before we lock the POC plan:

- Primary success criteria: 1) Extraction accuracy on our 3 canonical workflows (invoice parsing, product mapping, claims triage) must be >= 92% on our labeled set; 2) Average 95th percentile latency under 300ms for 512-token requests; 3) No data leaves our VPC during the trial.
- Evaluation window: 3 weeks of live traffic + synthetic test set run.
- Ownership: Priya (product) and Tom (platform) will be Arkhaven leads; Sean, Ben — we expect Redwood engineering support for SDK work and a short runbook for streaming.

Open Qs:
1) Can you provide the SDK route names and a short snippet for streaming + tool-calling to show our infra team?
2) Will you support a canary route (fallback to a smaller model) if the latency target breaches?

Attachments: our internal acceptance checklist (attached).

Thanks,
Priya
Senior PM, Arkhaven
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Raina <priya.r@arkhaven.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@arkhaven.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — Arkhaven evaluation priorities

Hi Priya — great notes, and thanks for laying out the acceptance criteria so clearly. Quick answers and a concrete plan below.

Short answers:
- SDK + streaming snippet: attaching a minimal node/python example and a patch with the streaming route names.
- Canary fallback: yes — Redwood can configure a route policy that falls back to the quantized fast-model if SLOs are missed (we'll include circuit-breaker thresholds).
- VPC private deployment: we'll provision a Private evaluation cluster in your VPC; we need one network CIDR and a short connectivity window to exchange IPs and certs.

Proposed trial plan (3-week cadence) — ownership and checkpoints:
Week 0 (Pre-kickoff):
- Action: Exchange network details + sign PO (Marissa) — due in 3 business days.
Week 1 (Integration & smoke):
- Action: Redwood engineering (Ben) will deliver SDK routes, sample streaming client, and one-pass integration call.
- Deliverable: SDK snippets + RAML of endpoints; initial latency baseline (synthetic).
Week 2 (Traffic run & monitoring):
- Action: Run against 10% production traffic + synthetic labeled set; Redwood to enable trace-level metrics to Arkhaven console.
- Deliverable: Automated eval report, 95th percentile latency, token cost estimate.
Week 3 (Acceptance & wrap):
- Action: Joint acceptance run using your labeled set; decision within 48 hours.
- Deliverable: Acceptance signoff or remediation plan.

Owners:
- Redwood: Ben (technical lead), Sean (AM), Marissa (contracts).
- Arkhaven: Tom (platform), Priya (product).

Next steps for today:
1) Ben will send the SDK routes + streaming example by EOD (attached).
2) Marissa will push the draft PO and MSA redlines to Priya.
3) Priya/Tom — please send the labeled test set link or a SFTP dropbox.

I attached the mutual-action-plan spreadsheet that maps the items above to dates. If that looks good, we’ll schedule the integration call and mark calendar invites.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-poc-mutual-action-plan.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@arkhaven.com>, Priya Raina <priya.r@arkhaven.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — Arkhaven evaluation priorities

Hi Priya / Tom — following up with the tech artifacts I promised. Key points first, then the snippets: 

Tech summary:
- Public endpoints you’ll call: POST /v1/generate (sync), POST /v1/stream (server-sent events) — we’ll provide an additional route name /v1/generate?variant=quantized for the fallback.
- Auth: API keys scoped to the trial project + HMAC header for streaming handshake.
- Tool calling: we support a structured "tool" param in the JSON body; Redwood runtime will route tool calls to your webhook URL (we will sign requests).
- Observability: trace id returned in X-Request-ID; we’ll add a dedicated dashboard for Arkhaven.

Minimal Node streaming example (excerpt):
- const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer KEY', 'X-HMAC':'xxx' }, body: JSON.stringify({input, tools:[{name:'catalog-lookup',url:'https://hooks.arkhaven/api/tool'}]}) });
- res.body.on('data', chunk => { /* partial tokens / tool call markers */ });

Acceptance checks I will run automatically:
- A1: Run labeled set through /v1/generate with model X-2 and produce confusion matrix + F1. Target >=92% accuracy on canonical flows.
- A2: Synthetic latency harness (10k requests) to compute p95. Target <300ms.
- A3: No external egress: validate VPC endpoints and confirm no outbound flows other than the signed tool webhook.

Attachments: redwood-sdk-snippet.patch (diff of the example SDK and route names).

I’ll be online for the 3pm integration call if we need to walk through the streaming handshake.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-sdk-snippet.patch
From: Priya Raina <priya.r@arkhaven.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@arkhaven.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — Arkhaven evaluation priorities

Thanks — this looks good and actionable. Quick confirmations: 
- We got the SDK snippet and the streaming example; Tom will validate the HMAC handshake tomorrow.
- PO: we’ll aim to return a signed PO by Friday (Priya).
- Test set: uploading labeled set to the Drive folder now (link: https://drive.google.com/arkhaven-labeled-set).

Can we also add one small acceptance item: a quality regression check that flags >5% drop vs baseline on the named entity extraction across the three flows? If that’s feasible to include automatically that would help product signoff.

If everyone agrees, let’s lock the integration slot for Thursday 3pm PT.

Best,
Priya
Senior PM, Arkhaven
